title: Per-tool manifest (v1)
description: Per-project per-tool upgrade state, stored at $ASDD_HOME/_state/tools/<project_id>/<tool_name>/manifest.json

schema_version.description: Bump on incompatible changes. Readers refuse unknown versions.

tool_name.description: Matches the tool registry key in asdd/tools.py.

current_version.description: Version currently pointed at by the overlay's bin/<binary> symlink. Must equal history[0].version.

set_at.description: Unix epoch seconds when the pin was set.

history.description: Most-recent-first. history[0] is the current version. Cap = 2 prior versions retained.

last_checked_at.description: Unix epoch seconds of the most recent successful upstream version probe. May be null when no check has run since first install.
